name: eip7702-userop-evidence
title: EIP-7702 UserOperation Evidence Pack
description: Three-step evidence pipeline for an EIP-7702 delegation that continues into an ERC-4337 account operation. The first step lints the authorization tuple in its pre-sign form and reports the signature-form facts that clients act on, including the EIP-2 low-s property and the zero-address delegation clear. The second step recovers the authority that signed that tuple and reports the delegate address the tuple names. The third step recomputes the v0.8 userOpHash over a UserOperation whose sender is the recovered authority and whose declared delegate is the tuple's delegate, so the same delegation appears in the account-operation hash that the account will sign. The three outputs compose into an evidence pack covering one delegation end to end. This is an evidence bundle and never a settlement proof: no chain is read, nothing is submitted, and every value is caller-declared and echoed.

steps.handoff: in mode eip7702_tuple the linter reports the tuple's policy facts, among them the EIP-2 low-s classification and the zero-address clear, and emits handoffs.art_614 with the tuple fields in the exact input shape of the recovery step
recovers the authority of that authorization tuple and reports it as recovered_signer beside the tuple's delegate_address, the two values the hash step reads

recomputes the v0.8 userOpHash over a UserOperation with sender equal to recovered_signer and eip7702Delegate equal to delegate_address, reporting eip7702_delegate_bound and sender_matches_declared_authority as the terminal facts in the assembled pack
